description: This file defines a NestJS controller for managing calendar integrations, including OAuth flows, calendar retrieval, busy times, and credentials management for various calendar services.

classes.name: CalendarState
classes.description: Interface representing the state information for calendar OAuth flows.

classes.name: CalendarsController
classes.description: NestJS controller handling calendar-related endpoints, including OAuth, calendar retrieval, busy times, and credentials management.

methods.name: createIcsFeed
methods.description: Saves an ICS feed for the user.

methods.name: checkIcsFeed
methods.description: Checks the status of the user's ICS feed.

methods.name: getBusyTimes
methods.description: Retrieves busy times from specified calendars within a date range.

methods.name: getCalendars
methods.description: Retrieves all calendars connected for the user.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Generates OAuth connect URL for specified calendar service.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves OAuth credentials for Google or Outlook calendars.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks connection status for specified calendar.

methods.name: deleteCalendarCredentials
methods.description: Disconnects a calendar and deletes credentials.
